items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 09 August 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centred to the east of Iceland will push as a waving frontal zone across the Irish Sea today.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, veering North or Northwest this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle today, then becoming fair later this evening or at first tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 or 4, falling Variable 2 or 3 later tomorrow, then settling Southeast 3 or 4 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
